blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag encouraged Vice President Sara Duterte to appear at the bureau and present what she described as “false accusations” made by dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. against her. This came after Duterte released a statement Monday evening saying they received Gracioso’s affidavit and that the former cop made 29 statements against her that she and her camp believe are “false.” READ: Sara Duterte expects NBI to file charges vs Gracioso When sought for his response, Matibag on Tuesday said in an interview that “it is easy to make claims,” but these […]...
